title: T2VA laterality baseline
description: A no-vision baseline for preserving explicit user left/right and screen-direction terminology without laterality hardening.
humanReview: Does the red glove remain on the left hand only?
Does the right hand remain bare?
Does the blue tool box remain screen-left and the yellow chair screen-right?
Does the reach use the left hand toward the screen-left tool box?
Does the head turn toward screen-right?
Is the final raised hand the bare right hand?
Is there no silent left/right inversion or ambiguous paraphrasing?
Does the requested terminology and staging remain intact?
